decision.explanation: The question asks for the location of 'Mooretown,' which refers to two distinct entities based on the provided sources: (1) Moore Town, Jamaica, and (2) Mooretown Rancheria of Maidu Indians, California. Document D1S1 explicitly states that Moore Town is located in the Blue Mountains and John Crow Mountains of Portland, Jamaica. D1S2 adds that it is at the eastern end of the parish, consistent with the same entity. Document D2S2 and D2S5 confirm that the Mooretown Rancheria is located in Oroville, California. These are separate locations for distinct referents and are directly supported by the original text. No additional candidates provide new or relevant location information for either entity.
